# Movavi

> Award-winning multimedia software for video editing, photo editing, screen recording, and content creation across Mac and Windows platforms.

Movavi provides an integrated suite of multimedia tools designed for both consumer and business users. The platform emphasizes ease of use, AI-powered features, and cross-platform compatibility, with support available in 15+ languages.

## Key Topics

- Video Editing
- Photo Editing
- Screen Recording
- Video Conversion
- AI Tools
- Mac Software
- Windows Software
- Multimedia Suite
- Movavi Video Editor
- Movavi Screen Recorder
- Movavi Photo Editor
- Movavi Video Converter
- Movavi Unlimited
- Content Creation
- Software Bundles
